calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_date
),
as_of AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS as_of_end
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date = params.as_of_date
),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    CROSS JOIN as_of
    WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364
      AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end
)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
CROSS JOIN as_of
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
                   AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((cur.tier), ())
ORDER BY cur.tier NULLS LAST

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_date
),
as_of AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS as_of_end
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date = params.as_of_date
),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    CROSS JOIN as_of
    WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364
      AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end
      AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude store 999 (training store) and web 900
      AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
CROSS JOIN as_of
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
                   AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
WHERE cur.tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cur.tier
ORDER BY cur.tier
